summary: GOWell Energy Technology (Nasdaq: GOW) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 11, 2026, announcing that its Singapore subsidiary, GOWell Technology Singapore Pte. Ltd., completed the acquisition of Well-Sense Holdings Ltd. (WellSense), an Aberdeen, Scotland-based provider of distributed fiber optic sensing and well-integrity diagnostics. Financial terms and purchase price were not disclosed; the deal was funded from existing cash. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock was named. The transaction is GOWell's first as a public company, integrating WellSense's FiberLine Intervention technology into its well-logging portfolio. Watch for integration execution and any later disclosure of deal economics.
